text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Ah! Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On my day off, I unexpectedly ran into 
legendary horse girls. Seeing them 
together is always dazzling and 
nerve-wracking, but with the three of them 
hanging out...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We are about to go out and have some 
fun.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, Trainer-san, would you care 
to join us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Spending time to deepen teamwork and 
contribute to the Twinkle Series... As a 
trainer, this should prove to be quite 
meaningful.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Trainer-kun... Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: No, well... ...Ah, whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tilting my head at Speed Symboli's 
unusually hesitant response... we arrived 
at an arcade. As I waited while the three 
said they needed to prepare—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ta-daaa~♪ How do you like our school 
uniforms!
choice_data_list: W-What on earth is going on...?!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, you mentioned earlier that 
the way we hung out felt just like school 
students, right?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
And then I remembered! Something I admired 
back when I was a student, but never got 
to do!
choice_data_list:
And that is... taking photo sticker booth 
pictures in uniform...?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
I had never known such a culture existed, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
It piqued my interest. So I consulted with 
Tazuna-chan and borrowed some academy 
supplies, you see.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Putting this on brings back memories of 
those days... It makes one's heart flutter 
with excitement, truly. Wouldn't you say 
so, Speed Symboli?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I ended up going along with it without 
thinking. Though actually wearing it like 
this...

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is admittedly a bit embarrassing. No, the 
two of you look wonderful, however.
choice_data_list: It suits all of you wonderfully...!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: You think so?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Since we're doing this, we should really 
get into the student mood and take great 
photos!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
For example... right, how about imagining 
someone's active racing days!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-san, who would you like to go 
with?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Me, you say?
choice_data_list:
I couldn't really picture it, so that made 
me curious.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, Saint Light-san would probably 
be sitting on a bench in the courtyard 
just like this♪

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Ah... reading a book in the courtyard on a 
pleasant, sunny day truly is delightful, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Back then as well, on days without 
training... I would often gaze blankly 
into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yet during races, I hear you were daring, 
valiant, and utterly fierce.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Hohoho. For some reason, everyone says 
that. I was simply strong, that is all...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that the image is coming 
together! Let's get right to taking 
photos♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Hm, me?
choice_data_list:
I imagined you must have been so glamorous 
and popular.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
I know, right! Like the cool senior 
everyone looked up to♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Back then on Valentine's Day, wasn't there 
a huge uproar? Everyone lining up saying, 
"This is for Senpai~"!

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Is that how it was? Nothing different from 
how things are now.

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... what a heartbreaker. Scattering 
dreams both then and now, I see.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
No, I think I was rather naive back then. 
Easily bewildered by the mere glare of the 
snow.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that the image is coming 
together! Let's get right to taking 
photos♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Oh! Me?!
choice_data_list:
Well, you're probably just like how you 
are now...?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Even my hairstyle is kept down to the 
millimeter just like it was back then!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
...Though isn't that a little lonely? It 
feels like there's no room for imagination 
just for me!

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, maybe I should switch up my look just 
for now? Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
A slightly bad-girl version of Haiseiko... 
or something!
choice_data_list:
You're plenty wonderful just the way you 
are.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, really? Then I guess being my natural 
self is best♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Alright, now that the image is coming 
together! Let's get right to taking 
photos♪

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm getting quite comfortable with 
this mood. Since we're doing it, might as 
well go all out!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. As long as one lives, youth is 
eternal. It would be a waste not to enjoy 
it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I watch over the three of them 
taking photo booth pictures.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text: Wah! The screen says "Pose cute!" Copy me♪

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Like this?

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Waa, perfect! Next is cool style... maybe 
like this?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Saint Light
text_block_list.text:
My, placing one's hands like this makes 
them resemble little ears. Splendid. Truly 
the wisdom of the younger generation.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-kun. Don't just stand there 
daydreaming—come join us.

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: We are accomplices in this, aren't we?

text_block_list.name: Speed Symboli
text_block_list.text: —Come, let's make a heart pose.
